description: Goal-conditioned line M2 (GOTO stage 1, user decisions 2026-09-30): GOTO_POSITION in emptied rooms (8 goals), after a won combat (4 goals) and in a real-floor chain (1 goal in A, then GOTO_DOOR to B), 1:1:1 by steps; trained on goal_rooms_train.json (393 of C39's 491 1x1 normal rooms; 20 % per solve class held out, design M2 / E-GOTO); the GOTO groups are evaluated on the 98 held-out rooms, the chain on all 491 (a chain with A and B both held out is rare; comparable with M1, EXPERIMENTS.md A12)
